name: Hammering Command
description: Speak a command with the weight of a hammer and let the body behind it fall as the word is finished.

name: Warded Command
description: Command a ward over the nearby allies and let the will in the word hold it against each blow.

name: Sundering Command
description: Send a command as a narrow lance of will that passes through armour and flesh and breaks the resolve behind.

name: Returning Command
description: Command the breath of a person who has just fallen to return and keep the will on them until it does.

name: Mandate Eternal
description: Proclaim a mandate that reaches the full field and holds every foe in it beneath its weight.

name: Intent Supreme
description: Drive a pure supreme intent into the foe's own will where no guard of any kind stands.

name: Command Reflected
description: Meet an overwhelming blow with a command to return and send the whole force back on its sender.

name: Resolve Perpetual
description: Hold a perpetual resolve over the nearby allies that shields them and gives back what each blow takes.

name: Absolute Intent
description: Hand down an absolute intent that strikes the foe's will directly and presses it flat with a weight scaling to the reserve.

name: Absolute Refusal
description: Refuse an incoming force outright so that it is undone on contact and returned with strength scaling to its weight.

name: Command Unanswerable
description: Give a command no one can answer and press the region beneath it to the destructive ceiling of a will master of this tier.

name: Intent Fulfilled
description: Declare an intention in full and have it simply be so across the field with no force or medium any mechanic can name.
